data.text:
Luke, I appreciate the sacrifice, but you shouldn’t have to go without income. I learned to fish from my family, and I want this lake to keep supporting all our families. I’d prefer we each take 10 tons: that gives everyone $10,000 and leaves 50 tons to replenish the lake fully every month.

If you’re set on taking zero, I’ll still choose 10, and I suggest the other three take no more than 13 each. That would keep our total at 49 or less and bring the lake back to 100 next month without relying on a future cutback. John, would you agree to the equal 10-ton plan?
